message.content: Starting triage on the reported energy violation — shrinking it to the minimal failing case.
Shrink isolated a compact two-body case. I'll replay it and examine the states leading to the violation.
Replay confirmed the failure is stable. Now I'll inspect the violation point and earlier steps.
Final energy is far above the start. I'll trace the buildup from the initial state.
Ledger: open - energy explosion cause (likely body-body collision energy gain with restitution + mass ratio); ruled out - controller (disabled, work 0). Need to see pre-violation progression.
Energy jumps only at the final step during body contact. I'll check earlier steps to confirm the collision timing.
The jump happens exactly at the body-body contact with a huge spurious transverse velocity. I'll test if inelastic collision removes it.
Switching to fully inelastic impact eliminated the jump, confirming restitution as the cause. I'll gather the final citations for the report.
